newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar Diamond files $850 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Ultramar Diamond files $850 mln shelf.

text.p: Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp filed a shelf offering with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission Friday for up to $850 million in debt securities, common shares and also preferred, which will be issued through special trusts.
When combined with previously-registered securities, the offering by the San Antonio, Texas, independent refiner and marketer of petroleum products shelf totals $900 million.
Proceeds from the sale will ultimately be used for general corporate purposes including capital expenditures, repaying outstanding debt and other business opportunities.
No underwriters were named in the shelf offering.
